gdesc.vow_of_clarity: Swear a Vow of clear thought: you regenerate mana. Reserves a small, flat amount of mana while sworn (it fits an early mana pool). Press again to break it (Vowbreak): for 4 seconds your skills cost no mana, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds and you are Forsworn.
gdesc.herald_of_embers: Swear a Herald of fire: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra fire damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into flame: 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as fire damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Fire and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
gdesc.summon_holy_elemental: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block (never past the 75% block cap, so a build already at the cap gains nothing from it) and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.
gdesc.woe_of_cinders: Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
gdesc.death_sentence: Sentence one enemy: it takes 25% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% more damage taken).
gdesc.woe_of_withering: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take more Poison damage, more damage of every kind and move slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
gdesc.vow_of_vigor: Swear a Vow of the living body: you regenerate life, and your attacks gain a little mana on hit. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Vowbreak: heal a quarter of your life at once and regenerate far faster for 4 seconds.
gdesc.herald_of_rime: Swear a Herald of cold: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra cold damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills shatter: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as cold damage within 3 metres (it chills). Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Cold and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
gdesc.summon_skeletal_mage: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 9, three from gem level 17. They stay until they fall.
gdesc.summon_bone_golem: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it; it burns in the colour of its supports' element. Only one answers at a time. Each golem blesses those near it: the grave golem heals you 1% of your life a second, the flame golem gives your minions 12.5% more damage, the ice golem gives you 31% more armour, the storm golem makes your minions 15% faster, and the venom golem makes enemies take 7.5% more damage. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
gdesc.vow_of_the_wind: Swear a Vow of the wind: 25% more Evasion at gem level 1, 44% at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Evasion bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 110% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
gdesc.summon_zombie: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 16, four from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.
gdesc.woe_of_rime: Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls by 20 and it moves 10% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
gdesc.woe_of_sundering: Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes 20% more Physical damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
gdesc.woe_of_the_tempest: Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls by 20. gdesc.herald_of_storms: Swear a Herald of lightning: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra lightning damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills arc to the 3 nearest enemies within 5 metres: 8% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as lightning damage. gdesc.woe_of_faltering: Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal 20% less damage and it moves 20% slower. gdesc.summon_skeletons: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more at gem levels 6, 11 and 16 (every 5 gem levels). While you are below level 10 it raises 2 more and costs half the mana, a starter's help that ends at level 10. They follow you and fight until they fall.
gdesc.herald_of_rot: Swear a Herald of poison: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra poison damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into rot: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as poison damage within 2.5 metres. gdesc.consecrated_ground: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.
gdesc.hallowed_slam: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds, one new patch a second: enemies on it burn for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second and take 8% more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.
